canonical_example.text: ¿Te estás copiando de mi tarea? ¡Te voy a acusar con la profesora!
canonical_example.translation: Are you copying my homework? I'm going to tell the teacher on you!

canonical_example.text: ¡Yo sé que fuiste tú la que me acusó con mi papá!
canonical_example.translation: I know it was you who snitched on me to my dad!

canonical_example.text: No pudo más con la culpa y se acusó de haber robado el dinero.
canonical_example.translation: He couldn't stand the guilt, and confessed to stealing the money.

unused_menu_senses.context: to admit blame; often used with "de"

source_metadata.context: to admit blame; often used with "de"

canonical_example.text: Los dos países se acusan de haber violado la Convención de Ginebra.
canonical_example.translation: The two countries accuse each other of breaking the Geneva Conventions.

unused_menu_senses.context: to blame each other; often used with "de"

source_metadata.context: to blame each other; often used with "de"

canonical_example.text: Me da tristeza ver como la enfermedad ya se le acusa en el rostro a Mario.
canonical_example.translation: It makes me sad to see how Mario's illness is starting to be apparent on his face.

canonical_example.text: La edad que tengo ya comienza a acusarse con estos achaques.
canonical_example.translation: My age is starting to show with all these aches and pains.
